$comment: World fields (ruleset v0): integer grids on the map's field cells (tech notes, section 6; spec S1, docs/design/spec-s1-water.md). Water depth is in micrometres (S1: rain and runoff add fractions of a millimetre per step), and each cell keeps four outflows in um/s of its own depth (virtual pipes, S1 section 2). Wetness and mud are on 0-65535 and get their rules with M3 item 4. tileCells: cells per side of an activity tile (16 = 24 m); sleepAfterSteps: quiet field steps before a tile sleeps (S1: 5). The water numbers are S1 proposals, tuned against the M3 tests, so the file is marked placeholder.

water.$comment: S1 section 2. pipeGainPermille = g * dt / cell = 9.81 * 0.1 / 1.5. Bed friction (S1's damping stand-in, made depth-aware) is the shallow-water coefficient c_f in millionths, tuned so the M3 river runs about 0.5 to 1 m/s at base flow: 0.0042, a normal river bed. The deadbands (S1's 1 mm/s and 1 mm sleep thresholds) let still water go quiet: a flow under 1 mm/s with under 1 mm of head behind it stops.
